wide.text: When a car turns, the outer wheel travels a longer circular arc than the inner wheel. An open differential lets one driveshaft turn both wheels at different speeds while keeping their torque equal.

Power comes in through the drive pinion and turns the ring gear bolted to the carrier. Inside, two orange spider gears ride on a cross-pin between the left sun gear and the right sun gear, which drive both half-shafts.

The eleven-tooth drive pinion drives the forty-one-tooth ring gear at a 3.73 to one reduction. eight hundred and twenty revolutions per minute at one hundred and ten newton-metres becomes two hundred and twenty revolutions per minute at four hundred and ten newton-metres on the carrier.

Going straight, both wheels turn at the same speed. The spider gears orbit with the carrier without spinning on their cross-pin, locking both sun gears to two hundred and twenty revolutions per minute.

Now enter a 7.50 metre left bend. The left wheel slows by twenty-two revolutions per minute to one hundred and ninety-eight, while the right wheel speeds up by twenty-two to two hundred and forty-two. Their speeds always add up to twice the carrier speed, four hundred and forty revolutions per minute, as the spider gears spin on their cross-pin at 35.2 revolutions per minute.

Because each spider gear pivots freely on its cross-pin, it pushes the left sun gear and the right sun gear with equal force. Both wheels always receive equal torque, two hundred and five newton-metres each, even when their speeds differ.

Put the left wheel on glare ice, and equal torque turns into a trap. The icy tire slips at ninety-six newton-metres, so the open differential caps the dry right wheel at ninety-six newton-metres too. With only one hundred and ninety-two newton-metres total — not enough to overcome the resistance holding the car still — the dry wheel stalls while the icy left wheel spins at twice carrier speed, four hundred and forty revolutions per minute, and the spider gears whirl at three hundred and fifty-two revolutions per minute.
